column1: # The releases at which the bash check of each rule changed, read by tests/releases.rs and by
# scripts/check-parity.sh. One row per rule of nuc, four or six fields separated by tabs: the rule
# ID; the script of the template that holds its bash check; the function of that script, or "-" for
# the whole script; the template releases at which that check changed, the earliest pinned release
# of the template left out, separated by commas, or "-" for none, where a release later than every
# tree of the template in the corpus is ahead of it and not compared until one is pinned; and, for
# a rule that checks some or every release alike although its bash changed, the releases the reason
# covers, separated by commas, or "-" for every release of the row, and the reason. A release there
# that does not parse is refused, and so is a reason whose first word reads as a release and is not
# one release followed by a word.
# scripts/check-parity.sh reads the first four fields. The parity harness compares each function
# across the trees of the template in the corpus, comment lines left out, and fails where this
# table says otherwise. tests/releases.rs fails on a rule whose check changed at a release no
# reason covers and that does not read the release the tree carries
# (API-version-coupling-hook-defaults). Only the named function is compared: a change to a helper
# it calls or a global it reads, as placeholder or add_error, shows in no row, and is found by
